Liiga team history

Source: R/liiga.R
liiga_teams_history.Rd

Every team's regular-season record, one row per team and season since 1976.

Usage

liiga_teams_history()

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (25 columns; zero rows when a valid payload has none).

col_nametypedescription
idintegerRow id of this team-season row (NOT a team id; teamId is the team).
seasonintegerSeason END year (2026 = 2025-26).
league_idintegerLeague id: 1 = Liiga (SM-liiga) on every /teams/info row 1976-2027.
serie_idintegerTournament id, the same every season: 1188 regular season, 1189 playoffs, 1194 preseason, 1890 CHL.
team_idintegerTeam id, the number of Liiga's <num>:<slug> team key (sent as that string, a bare integer or a digit string depending on the route).
away_gamesintegerAway games (team, that regular season).
away_lossesintegerAway losses (team, that regular season).
away_tiesintegerAway ties (team, that regular season).
away_winsintegerAway wins (team, that regular season).
away_wins_in_extra_timeintegerAway wins in extra time (team, that regular season).
gamesintegerGames (team, that regular season).
goals_againstintegerGoals against (team, that regular season).
goals_scoredintegerGoals scored (team, that regular season).
home_gamesintegerHome games (team, that regular season).
home_lossesintegerHome losses (team, that regular season).
home_tiesintegerHome ties (team, that regular season).
home_winsintegerHome wins (team, that regular season).
home_wins_in_extra_timeintegerHome wins in extra time (team, that regular season).
lossesintegerLosses (team, that regular season).
playoff_rankintegerPlayoff rank (team, that regular season).
pointsintegerPoints (team, that regular season).
regular_season_rankintegerRegular season rank (team, that regular season).
tiesintegerTies (team, that regular season).
winsintegerWins (team, that regular season).
wins_in_extra_timeintegerWins in extra time (team, that regular season).

Details

Endpoint: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/teams/info (with team=all)

Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26), the same key as sdv-py. Requests to liiga.fi are spaced at least one second apart. A request Liiga answers with nothing (an unknown game, a tournament not played that season, a shot map before 2016) raises fastRhockey_no_data; a failed fetch or an error-shaped answer raises fastRhockey_asset_fetch; a bad argument raises fastRhockey_bad_request.

See also

Other Liiga Functions: liiga_game(), liiga_game_goals(), liiga_game_lineups(), liiga_game_penalties(), liiga_game_players_stats(), liiga_game_shootout(), liiga_game_stats(), liiga_game_team_stats(), liiga_games(), liiga_gameweeks(), liiga_goals(), liiga_player(), liiga_player_career(), liiga_player_game_log(), liiga_player_stats(), liiga_players_info(), liiga_schedule(), liiga_shotmap(), liiga_standings(), liiga_team_stats(), liiga_teams(), liiga_tournament()
